translation_notes: the two `g.add((s, ...))` calls share the subject `s` with nothing between them, so they merge into one `+{ {s} a <...Catalog> ; dct:title "Cat" }` under `@graph g`. `RDF.type` becomes `a`, so `@prefix rdf:` (in the mechanical draft) would go unused and was dropped -- same reasoning as the sibling Dewberry/FAIRDataTeam-applier regions in this stratum.

`URIRef("http://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Catalog")` stays a bare `<...>` IRI, not a `dcat:` prefixed name: the original writes it as a raw string constant, not through a DCAT namespace object (DCAT is not even imported in this file) -- introducing a prefix the source never declares would not be the most faithful reading, only the most compact one.

`DCT.title` -> `dct:title`: `from fdpneo_server.shared.namespaces import DCT, FDP_METADATA_STATE, SH` is the ns_import_project idiom (a project-level namespace import), so the most specific translation carries it as `from context_shim import dct:` rather than degrading it to a Python interpolation `{DCT.title}` -- same choice as the sibling FAIRDataTeam-applier region in this stratum, which verified DCT's real IRI (http://purl.org/dc/terms/) against fdpneo_server/shared/namespaces.py at this commit; reused here rather than re-deriving it. FDP_METADATA_STATE and SH are imported by the original but never read inside this six-line region, so they are dropped from both original.py's and translated.ldpy's import line (see context_shim.py) rather than invented.
context_shim.py (new for this region: `fdpneo_server` is not installed -- `import fdpneo_server` -> ModuleNotFoundError, checked directly) carries only DCT, the one name this region actually uses.
checked that the pilot discriminates: changing the merged literal to "Broken" makes `rdfeval check` fail with 'graphs not isomorphic (2 vs 2 triples)'.
